text: New legal precedents, regulations, and ethical considerations can be integrated into an existing WDAG governance structure without a complete overhaul of the framework, which is what keeps the governance system current as AI technology and societal expectations move.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, AI Governance Via Web3 Reputation System (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4941807

isBasedOn.name: AI Governance Via Web3 Reputation System

abstract: As new legal precedents, regulations, or ethical considerations arise, they can be seamlessly integrated into the existing WDAG structure without necessitating a complete overhaul of the governance framework.

value: where new governance elements can be added as vertices and edges to the existing graph
